title: The cards cover
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is four index cards on a counter: two face down, one blank, one that says maple bars. The owner reads the one she can. She says what about the others. Wood says they're face down. She says she can see that. He says then she knows what he knows.

panels.composition: The cover: four index cards on a wooden counter, two face down, one blank, one with two words.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing four index cards on a counter, two face down, one blank and one with a short handwritten answer, black and white, no words
image.notes: Letter after: maple bars (the one card).

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner holding a small booklet with index cards on its cover and speaking to a young man, black and white, no words

balloons.text: Then you know what I know.

image.prompt: a young man in a chore coat, level, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The rack. The cards facing the room, two of them facing nothing. The town reads the one it can. The strip keeps the other three.

notes: 'Then you know what I know.' Two face down, forever.
